objective: GroupGuard only handles command intake, intranet requests, protocol validation, and OneBot delivery. Public upstream access, business processing, rendering, caching, and degradation are owned by lolapisevers.

steps.summary: Pinned the service fixtures, added strict delivery parsing and image integrity checks, converted validated payloads to OneBot plans, and proved the new client makes one intranet request with no public fallback.
Wire the validated intranet client into real commands and the admin tester so both paths use one request implementation.
Remove plugin-side shard downloads, hero matching, sorting, formatting decisions and public fallback after the service release is accepted.
Move ARAM and ban commands to the final delivery envelope; battle-query migration is handled only after its delivery feature is defined.
Keep one intranet API base for built-in LoL queries and deprecate public upstream configuration.
Expand the current new-client gate into a repository architecture test that rejects public upstream access from all built-in LoL query modules.
Deploy GroupGuard only after the compatible service release and complete real-member acceptance tests.

current_findings.summary: The current real shard command still downloads public shard and hero JSON from SnowLuma; the new strict client is not wired into commands yet.
The built-in ban path still supports direct public providers when the intranet base is absent; this migration fallback remains until command unification.
The compatible delivery service has not yet been integrated and deployed to the Windows intranet computer, so runtime command migration must not start.
Legacy command handlers still interpret and format business data instead of consuming the final delivery payload.

next_recommended_action.summary: Integrate and deploy the green service stack first, warm snapshots, verify old-plugin compatibility and offline fallback, then return to GG-CLIENT-001.

production_rule: Deploy lolapisevers first, verify backward compatibility and restart/offline acceptance, then migrate GroupGuard. Never restore plugin-side public fallback.
